counting_policy: 424 non-Bevy tests + 51 Bevy renderer-library tests + 21 Bevy integration tests + 86 native demo tests. The 31 no-default library cases also appear in the renderer library and count once. Empty doctest harnesses, targeted reruns, examples, process smoke checks, native interactions and historical reports add no Rust cases.

isolated_native_demo_revalidation.reason: Final small-viewport/150%-text native passes identified footer layout and nested inspector focus reveal defects. Only the listed native-demo source files changed. The non-Bevy workspace gate explicitly excludes terra-demo, and the Bevy library/integration gates do not depend on terra-demo. Their tested source inputs remain unchanged. The demo tests, native executable and final formatting gate are revalidated after the isolated UI polish.

native_evidence_summary.provenance: Each capture retains its actual review-stage executable hash. Earlier gameplay/world-creation captures are not relabeled as the final nested-scroll confirmation build.

measurement_provenance: Final Rust validation references the final frozen formatted source and exact gate log digests. Isolated native-demo polish after the initial gate snapshot is recorded with both input hashes and explicit revalidation; retained headless/Bevy gates have unchanged applicable source inputs. The separately recorded server process smoke retains its own binary, script and bundle hashes; its prior executable is not silently relabeled as the final renderer build. Versioned 0.8 checkpoint/session timings remain historical measurements and are excluded from 0.9 test totals. Correctness tests ran while native review work was in progress; their durations are not performance or concurrency benchmarks.
scope: Bounded Rust correctness, actual localhost TCP/TLS and SQLite recovery, plus separately recorded Linux/X11 native interaction with Mesa software Vulkan. No full Motor Town parity, AAA art/rigid-body physics, gaming-GPU frame-time certification, physical device certification, public-account hosting, distributed authority or MMORPG concurrent-player claim.
